originalTitle: Oil prices rise after Treasury Secretary says U.S. will collapse Iran with economic pressure
summary: Oil moved higher Thursday after U.S. President Donald Trump sharpened his rhetoric against Iran.
content:
Oil moved higher Thursday after Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the U.S. will impose the toughest sanctions in history against Iran.

"We have the blockade and we are going to have the toughest sanctions in history," Bessent told CNBC in an interview. "This will work. It worked in Venezuela once we put up the blockade. It is working in Cuba right now and it is going to work in Iran, and we are going to collapse this regime."

Brent crude futures , the international benchmark, rose 2.4% to close at $93.78 per barrel. U.S. West Texas Intermediate futures for October delivery were 2.7% higher at $86.64.

Bessent said he will hold a press conference Monday to lay out President Donald Trump's plan to wage "economic warfare" against Iran.

Trump on Wednesday threatened Iran with the "MOST CRUSHING ECONOMIC OPERATION EVER TAKEN AGAINST ANY COUNTRY!" in a Truth Social post. The president said any country that does business with Iran will face economic consequences.

Oil prices rose more than 3% earlier in the session on Trump's threat. Bessent told CNBC on Thursday that the market was misinterpreting the president's comments. The U.S. ramping up economic pressure means there likely will not be a return to large-scale combat operations, he said.

"I'm not sure why oil has popped up on this," Bessent said. "If we are doing the maximum economic pressure, then that means that likely there will not be a large-scale kinetic restart."

The oil price rise also comes after the UAE said Wednesday it was halting all trade and financial transactions with Iran after the Gulf state said it had come under fire from the Islamic Republic on Tuesday.

The UAE, one of Iran's key commercial partners, said two ballistic missiles had been launched toward its territory from Iran. Iran's foreign ministry spokesperson Esmail Baghaei denied the strikes.

The move heaps further pressure on Iran, which is already facing economic sanctions from the U.S., and pushes the prospect of any renewed ceasefire agreement further from view.
chineseTitle: 财政部长表示美国将通过经济压力摧毁伊朗，油价上涨
chineseSummary: 在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普加强针对伊朗的言论后，油价周四走高。
chineseContent:
在财政部长斯科特·贝森特表示美国将对伊朗实施历史上最严厉的制裁后，油价周四走高。

贝森特在接受 CNBC 采访时表示：“我们实施了封锁，我们将实施历史上最严厉的制裁。” “这会起作用。一旦我们实行封锁，它就在委内瑞拉起作用了。它现在在古巴起作用，也将在伊朗起作用，我们将推翻这个政权。”

国际基准布伦特原油期货上涨 2.4%，收于每桶 93.78 美元。 10 月交割的美国西德克萨斯中质原油期货上涨 2.7%，至 86.64 美元。

贝森特表示，他将于周一举行新闻发布会，阐述唐纳德·特朗普总统对伊朗发动“经济战”的计划。

特朗普周三威胁伊朗，将“对任何国家采取有史以来最具毁灭性的经济行动！”在真相社会帖子中。总统表示，任何与伊朗做生意的国家都将面临经济后果。

由于特朗普的威胁，油价在盘中早些时候上涨了 3% 以上。贝森特周四对 CNBC 表示，市场误解了总统的言论。他说，美国加大经济压力意味着大规模作战行动可能不会恢复。

“我不知道为什么石油会突然出现在这个地方，”贝森特说。 “如果我们施加最大的经济压力，那么这意味着可能不会出现大规模的动态重启。”

油价上涨也是在阿联酋周三表示将停止与伊朗的所有贸易和金融交易之后，海湾国家周二表示遭到伊朗伊斯兰共和国的攻击。

伊朗主要商业伙伴之一阿联酋表示，伊朗已向其领土发射了两枚弹道导弹。伊朗外交部发言人埃斯梅尔·巴格海否认了此次袭击。

此举给已经面临美国经济制裁的伊朗带来了进一步的压力，并进一步推动了重新达成停火协议的前景。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于财经市场信号，适合用于观察利率、汇率、股债商品、金融机构和宏观政策变化。
